# Character controller

Query target: `CHARACTER_CONTROLLER`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [move](#move) | write | world-space displacement applied once at commit |

## move

`f32`; units: [distance](units.md#length); frame: world.

| Access | Layout | Memory |
|---|---|---|
| Write | fixed, shape [objects], 3 lanes | CPU |

**Write:** requires [Cct move](#cct-move).

Runs a command; executes once. Visibility: commit.

## Conditions

### Cct move

Finite world displacement executes once at commit on CPU/readback. The caller supplies gravity or grounding displacement; repeated zero moves do not guarantee sustained following of a moving platform. DirectGPU is refused; backing rigid pose changes on the next simulation step.
